What is MeowTrail?

MeowTrail is a cat-themed logic puzzle game based on the classic Akari (Light Up) puzzle by Nikoli. Place glowing cats on a grid to illuminate every white cell, following numbered clues on black walls. No two cats can see each other in the same row or column.

How to Play

  1. Click a white cell to place or remove a glowing cat.
  2. Each cat illuminates its entire row and column until blocked by a black wall.
  3. Numbered black cells show how many adjacent (up/down/left/right) cells must contain cats.
  4. No two cats can see each other — if two are in the same row or column with no wall between, that's illegal.
  5. All white cells must be illuminated to win.

Double-click (or right-click / long-press on mobile) to mark a cell with a paw print — useful for noting cells you know can't have cats.

Difficulty Levels

  • Easy (7×7) — Perfect for beginners. More numbered clues, simpler deduction chains.
  • Medium (10×10) — The standard challenge. Requires intermediate techniques like cross-hatching.
  • Hard (12×12) — For experienced puzzlers. Fewer clues, deeper reasoning required.

Tips & Strategy

Start with extremes

  • "4" cells — all four neighbors must be cats. Place them immediately.
  • "0" cells — none of its neighbors can have cats. Mark them with paw prints.

Use line-of-sight

  • Once you place a cat, every cell in its row and column (until a wall) is automatically lit and cannot hold another cat.
  • Look for cells that can only be lit from one direction — those are forced placements.

FAQ

What is a light up puzzle?

A light up puzzle (also called Akari) is a logic puzzle where you place light bulbs to illuminate every white cell. MeowTrail is the cat-themed version — place glowing cats instead of bulbs!

How do I play akari puzzle online?

Visit meowtrail.org and click any white cell to place a cat. Each cat lights up its entire row and column until blocked by a wall. Follow the numbered clues to solve the puzzle!

What is Akari (Light Up)?

Akari is a logic puzzle created by Nikoli. Place light bulbs so every white cell is illuminated. MeowTrail is the cat-themed version.

Is MeowTrail free?

Yes! Play online for free right here at meowtrail.org.

Can I play on mobile?

Absolutely. The grid is responsive and works on any screen size. Long-press to mark cells with paw prints.
